SL = M15 lower band price
TP = M30 upper band price
rr = tpdist / sldist (median 0.73 — mostly < 1)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="360" x="990" y="790" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s3dn" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=8;" value="DOWN (SELL):
SL = M15 upper band price
TP = M30 lower band price" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="66" width="360" x="990" y="885" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s3note" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;fontSize=9;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;fontStyle=2;" value="set pos.open=true, entry bar, trigger state; TP/SL sourced from bands at entry bar (NOT adjusted for confirmation lag)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="20" width="800" x="100" y="980" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g-exit" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=none;strokeColor=#d79b00;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=6;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;" value="EXIT (checked every M5 bar while open, STRICT PRIORITY 1-4, line 812/1014)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="560" width="1560" x="50" y="1080" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="x1" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=8;" value="1 TP_HIT (line 814): UP close >= TP / DOWN close <= TP -> act=7
RESULT: 45 trades, 100% win, +$1138" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="900" x="80" y="1120" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ex1" edge="1" parent="1" source="x1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;endArrow=block;" target="ll-exit"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="1415" y="1145" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="x2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=8;" value="2 M15_REVERT (line 827): m15_state != trigger target state -> act=7
RESULT: 152 trades, -$1801 = 87.6% of gross loss. THE loss channel.
split: TRUE_REVERSAL (M15->opp) 53 trades -$1045 7.5%WR | PAUSE_CUT (S/C) = rest. MIXED — can't simply loosen." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="900" x="80" y="1185" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ex2" edge="1" parent="1" source="x2" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;endArrow=block;" target="ll-exit"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="1415" y="1220" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="x3" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=8;" value="3 TIMEOUT (line 838): 12 M5 bars elapsed AND m30 never reached trigger state -> act=7
(m30_followed disarms this once M30 follows)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="900" x="80" y="1270" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ex3" edge="1" parent="1" source="x3" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;endArrow=block;" target="ll-exit"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="1415" y="1295" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="x4" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=8;" value="4 SL_HIT (line 850): price hits M15-band stop (best-effort log; broker may execute at tick before bar seen)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="44" width="900" x="80" y="1335" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ex4" edge="1" parent="1" source="x4" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;html=1;endArrow=block;" target="ll-exit"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="1415" y="1357" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="x5" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=8;" value="RETRY LIFECYCLE (V36.13 orphan fix): any act=7 not confirmed flat re-issues each bar; pos.open cleared ONLY when BUYS==0 AND SELLS==0; entries blocked while exit_pending. (Fixed the 3.5-month orphan that froze the EA at 17 trades -> unfroze to 214.)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="1440" x="80" y="1395" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="xnote" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;fontSize=9;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;fontStyle=2;" value="Priority means: on a bar where BOTH TP and revert conditions hold, TP_HIT wins. M15_REVERT fires on ANY departure from trigger state (R, S, or C for an UP trade) — this catches pauses AND true reversals, which is why loosening it holds through the worst trades." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="1400" x="80" y="1465" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="verdict" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;align=left;spacingLeft=8;fontSize=11;" value="VERDICT — CLOSED. Premise: 'M15 band-state flip predicts direction.' V36.13 M15-alone = -$899, PF 0.61, 214 trades, NOT-SEPARABLE (no entry feature separates 45 TP winners from 152 reverters). V36.14 M30-confirmed = PF 0.71 OOS (n=169; PRE 0.66 / POST 0.88). S-F HTF-filter variant failed OOS (3.62 -> 0.13). Three confirmation levels all failed out-of-sample. Documented CLOSED in DUALTF_ARCHITECTURE.md. Part 3 identification (states/bbloc) stays valid; only this trade premise is dead." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="1560" x="50" y="1660" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div: Priority means: on a bar where BOTH TP and revert conditions hold, TP_HIT wins. M15_REVERT fires on ANY departure from trigger state (R, S, or C for an UP trade) — this catches pauses AND true reversals, which is why loosening it holds through the worst trades.

div.div: VERDICT — CLOSED. Premise: 'M15 band-state flip predicts direction.' V36.13 M15-alone = -$899, PF 0.61, 214 trades, NOT-SEPARABLE (no entry feature separates 45 TP winners from 152 reverters). V36.14 M30-confirmed = PF 0.71 OOS (n=169; PRE 0.66 / POST 0.88). S-F HTF-filter variant failed OOS (3.62 -> 0.13). Three confirmation levels all failed out-of-sample. Documented CLOSED in DUALTF_ARCHITECTURE.md. Part 3 identification (states/bbloc) stays valid; only this trade premise is dead.
